posts.post:
some people treat their closet like a museum they aren't allowed to touch.

wear the 'good' clothes to get coffee. stop saving them for ghosts.
belts: a necessary piece of hardware or just a claustrophobic cage for your torso?
the most judgmental people at the party are always the ones wearing the most uncomfortable shoes. we know you're miserable.
nothing builds character like trying to zip up a dress by yourself while your arm is at an impossible angle.
